source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Note 15 Income Taxes, income taxes paid
source.quote: Total income taxes, net of amounts refunded $ 129,390 [USD thousands; year ended December 31, 2025]

notes: Taxes: the FY2025 income-tax note's table of income taxes paid by jurisdiction (federal 35,000; California 19,465; other state and local 31,869; United Kingdom 33,665; other foreign 9,391 thousand), total net of refunds; tagged us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid. R&D not reported as a separate line. Block reports 'Product development' ($2,907,889 thousand in 2025; tagged us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense in XBRL), which the 10-K describes as engineering, data science and design personnel and infrastructure costs without calling it research and development, so it is not recorded.
